subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"A person who eats too much
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Glutton**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glutton"** refers to a person who eats or consumes food in excess or greedily. (पेटू)

 
 
• **Example:** He is such a glutton that he ate an entire pizza by himself in just 10 minutes.
 
 
 
• **"Gourmet"** refers to a connoisseur of good food; someone with a refined taste, especially for food and drink. (खानपान में पारखी)
 
 
• **Example:** As a gourmet, she always chooses the finest restaurants to dine in.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that describes "a person who eats too much" is **"Glutton"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**, **Glutton**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gourmet** (खानपान में पारखी): Someone who has a refined palate for good food and drink.

 
 
• **Example:** Being a gourmet, he can distinguish between different types of cheese with ease.
 
 
 
• **Epicure** (रसिक): A person who takes great pleasure in fine food and drink.
 
 
• **Example:** As an epicure, she loves attending wine-tasting events.
 
 
 
• **Connoisseur** (पारखी): An expert judge in matters of taste, such as art, food, or wine.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a connoisseur of classical music and can recognize composers by listening to a few notes.
